svg.aria-label: The same brief for a logo named Stow, run once by an agent alone and once with Kothar; an orange frame checks both logos at 16 px and in one colour: the first blurs and turns into a black square, the Kothar one stays sharp and keeps its shape

text.tspan: One agent, two runs: once on its own,
